steps.description:
Write a program to perform the following using 2 functions:

1. Call a function which takes in a filename data1.txt. The function repeatedly asks user to enter a string and save it to the file. If the file exists, it should be overwritten. Each entry should be on a new line in the file. This step ends when user enters "end". 2. Call the same function with filename data2.txt and perform the same task until user enters "end". 3. Call another function which takes in a filename data1.txt. It will read the file line by line and display them. 4. Call the same function with filename data2.txt and perform the same task.

For example: data1.txt contains: 1 2 data2.txt contains: a b c d

it will display: 1 2 a b c d

Do not use list to store all the contents of the files.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input

1 2 3 4 end a b c end

apple orange pear end grapes kiwi pineapple honey dew lemon end

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Recording data1.txt Enter text: 1 Enter text: 2 Enter text: 3 Enter text: 4 Enter text: end Recording data2.txt Enter text: a Enter text: b Enter text: c Enter text: end 1 2 3 4 a b c

Example 2 Recording data1.txt Enter text: apple Enter text: orange Enter text: pear Enter text: end Recording data2.txt Enter text: grapes Enter text: kiwi Enter text: pineapple Enter text: honey dew Enter text: lemon Enter text: end apple orange pear grapes kiwi pineapple honey dew lemon

Write a program to perform the following using 2 functions:

1. Call a function which takes in a filename data1.txt. The function repeatedly asks user to enter a string and save it to the file. If the file exists, it should be overwritten. Each entry should be on a new line in the file. This step ends when user enters "end". 2. Call the same function with filename data2.txt and perform the same task until user enters "end". 3. Call another function which opens data1.txt and data2.txt. It will then read a line alternately from each file and display them on separate rows. It will continue to do so until all the lines are displayed. If one file ends first, it will just display the remaining lines from the other file.

For example: data1.txt contains: 1 2 data2.txt contains: a b c d

it will display: 1 a 2 b c d

Do not use list to store all the contents of the files.

Example 2 Recording data1.txt Enter text: apple Enter text: orange Enter text: pear Enter text: end Recording data2.txt Enter text: grapes Enter text: kiwi Enter text: pineapple Enter text: honey dew Enter text: lemon Enter text: end apple grapes orange kiwi pear pineapple honey dew lemon
